dedupe_keys.name: ribuild measurements at case buildings with internal insulation dk lv it

description: RIBuild researchers publish measured conditions at internally insulated buildings in Denmark, Latvia and Italy. The observations mainly comprise temperature and relative humidity, with some sites also recording heat flow, volumetric water content, wind and solar radiation. The source states that these data support recommendations on insulation systems and were intended to validate simulations produced by the RIBuild web tool. Zenodo lists 32 CSV and XLSX files and provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Files and measurement points form one multi-country case-study collection. The related RIBuild historic-building survey supplies renovation context, while Swiss and German monitoring are separately described resources. A limitation is that complete observation dates, sampling intervals and site-specific variable coverage are not stated in the inspected description. Measurement values, sensor calibration and any achieved agreement with simulations were not checked.
